schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 003A - Tool Event Fanout

questions.label: When multiple active plugin panels support a tool call, what should happen?
questions.help: Recommended: one runtime tool call creates one C4OS tool event, then all active compatible plugin views receive it. This matches loading x.com in two active browser panels without letting each plugin independently multiply backend authority.
options: One tool call event fans out to all active compatible plugin views
Each active compatible plugin invokes its own backend tool instance
Only the currently focused compatible plugin receives the tool event

questions.label: What about enabled but hidden compatible plugins?
questions.help: Recommended: hidden plugins do not receive view events by default. They can read persisted tool state later if opened, depending on plugin config.
options: Hidden plugins do not receive view events by default
Enabled hidden plugins receive events too
Plugin config decides whether hidden views receive events
